prompt_text:
Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams audio chunks from an async source using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 2 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 3 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 4 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 5 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 6 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import asyncio
import os
from typing import AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, List, Optional

import azure.cognitivespeech as speechsdk


async def stream_speech_to_text(audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    """
    Stream audio chunks from an async source to Azure Speech and yield recognized text.
    Requires:
      - AZURE_SPEECH_KEY
      - AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
    """
    speech_key = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"]
    speech_region = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"]

    speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=speech_region)
    speech_config.speech_recognition_language = os.getenv("AZURE_SPEECH_LANGUAGE", "en-US")

    # Use push audio input so we can feed an async source chunk-by-chunk.
    stream_format = speechsdk.audio.AudioStreamFormat(
        samples_per_second=int(os.getenv("AZURE_SPEECH_SAMPLE_RATE", "16000")),
        bits_per_sample=16,
        channels=1,
    )
    push_stream = speechsdk.audio.PushAudioInputStream(stream_format)
    audio_config = speechsdk.audio.AudioConfig(stream=push_stream)
    recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=audio_config)

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    queue: asyncio.Queue[Optional[str]] = asyncio.Queue()
    done = asyncio.Event()

    def _recognized(evt):
        result = evt.result
        if result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech and result.text:
            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(queue.put_nowait, result.text)

    def _session_stopped(evt):
        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(done.set)

    def _canceled(evt):
        cancellation = evt.result
        if cancellation and getattr(cancellation, "reason", None) == speechsdk.CancellationReason.Error:
            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(queue.put_nowait, f"ERROR: {cancellation.error_details}")
        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(done.set)

    recognizer.recognized.connect(_recognized)
    recognizer.session_stopped.connect(_session_stopped)
    recognizer.canceled.connect(_canceled)

    recognizer.start_continuous_recognition()

    async def _feed_audio():
        try:
            async for chunk in audio_chunks:
                if chunk:
                    push_stream.write(chunk)
                await asyncio.sleep(0)
        finally:
            push_stream.close()

    feeder = asyncio.create_task(_feed_audio())

    try:
        while True:
            if done.is_set() and queue.empty():
                break
            try:
                text = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), timeout=0.1)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                if feeder.done() and done.is_set() and queue.empty():
                    break
                continue
            if text:
                yield text
    finally:
        try:
            recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition()
        finally:
            if not feeder.done():
                feeder.cancel()
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    await feeder


async def transcribe_audio_chunks(audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes]) -> List[str]:
    results: List[str] = []
    async for text in stream_speech_to_text(audio_chunks):
        results.append(text)
    return results
